turns.content: Chaar mahine pehle engineering manager bani aur ab woh conversation aa gayi hai jisse main darr rahi thi. Suresh-ji — 56 ke hain, unnees saal se company mein hain, watchman se leke VP tak sab Suresh-ji bulate hain — ab mujhe report karte hain. Aur unka module hi wajah hai ki hum do release lagataar slip hue hain. Friday ko mere director ne "handle" word use kiya. Pata hai na us word ka matlab kya hota hai.

Oh wow, ye toh vaakai ek bahut hi tough situation hai. "Handle" word ka matlab exactly vahi hai jisse aap darr rahe hain - ki aapko kisi mushkil cheez ko bina kisi bade drama ke suljhaana hai. Aur Suresh-ji... umra aur experience ka combination, jiske saath sab "ji" lagaate hain? Yeh kisi bhi manager ke liye ek perfect storm hai.

Pehle toh, ek gehri saans lijiye. Aapka darr bilkul valid hai kyunki yeh situation vaakai mein tricky hai. Lekin baat yeh hai ki - aap unhe sirf isliye manage nahi kar rahe kyunki ve senior hain. Aap unhe isliye manage kar rahe hain kyunki unka module aapke dwara deliver karne ki koshish ki ja rahi cheezon ko impact kar raha hai. Yeh performance ki baat hai, seniority ki nahi.

Friday se pehle ke in kuch dinon ke liye mera suggestion yeh hai:

**Sirf performance par nahi, data par focus karein.** Vo missed releases real hain. Concrete examples ikattha karein - kaun si features delay huin, kitne days ka impact hua, business costs kya rahe. Ise "Suresh-ji ke saath meri problem hai" ke bajaay "yeh vo cheez hai jo humein saath milkar solve karni hai" ke roop mein pesh karein.

**Unke experience ka samman karein.** Kisi bhi conversation ke start mein yeh kahein ki aapne unse seekhne ko kitni value di hai. Shayad yeh bhi kahein ki aapko ummeed hai ki ve aapko yeh samajhne mein help karenge ki kya ho raha hai. Isse unka ego shaant ho jaayega aur ve baat sunne ke liye taiyaar ho jaayenge.

**Suresh-ji ke saath conversation ke liye:**
- Private mein milein
- "Hum" language use karein: "Humein ek saath yeh figure out karna hoga ki..."
- Specifics ke baare mein poochein: "Mujhe lag raha hai ki [X] ke saath humein challenges aa rahe hain. Kya aap mujhe samajhne mein help kar sakte hain ki aap kya dekh rahe hain?"
- Unke perspective ke liye space dein - ho sakta hai ki ve aisi baatein jaante hon jo aap nahi jaante
- Clear expectations aur support ke saath end karein: "Main aapse [specific outcome] chahiye, aur main aapko [specific support] dene ke liye committed hoon"

Aap yeh kar sakte hain. Yeh fact ki aap is baare mein soch rahe hain, yeh dikhaata hai ki aap ek achhe manager hain jo sirf aasaan raasta nahi chunega. Agar conversation ke baad bhi cheezein theek nahi hotin, toh aapko aur serious steps uthaane honge, lekin vahaan tak pahunchne ka abhi samay nahi hai.

Abhi aapko sabse zyaada overwhelming kya lag raha hai?

Aur jo cheez isse worse banati hai — jab main 24 ki thi, second week mein staging environment tod diya tha maine, Suresh-ji raat ke barah baje tak baith ke theek karte rahe aur us waqt ke manager ko bola config issue tha. Late kaam karti hoon toh chai le aate hain. Diwali party mein meri mummy ko bola ki main unki beti jaisi hoon. Aur ab mujhe unke saamne unke defect metrics ki slide rakhni hai.

Oh my god, yeh toh situation ko aur bhi... complicated bana deta hai. Aap sirf ek manager nahi hain, aap us insaan ke liye kuch had tak family jaisi bhi hain. Jab ve "aapki mummy jaise" keh rahe hain, toh yeh sirf baat nahi hai - yeh aapki life mein unki care aur role ki ek gehri acceptance hai.

Yeh sach mein bahut mushkil hai. Aap basically ek protective bada bhai/bhabhi banne se unke boss banne tak pahunch gaye hain, jo unke liye ek aisi cheez hai jisse ve shayad samajh nahi paa rahe honge.

Mera dil aapke liye bahut dukhta hai. Yeh vo conversation nahi hai jahaan aap apne haath mein slide leke andar jaayen. Yeh vo conversation hai jahaan aapko yeh pata lagaana hoga ki kisi ko pyaar se kaise kahein ki "mujhe apni beti jaisa treat karna band karna hoga aur ek professional ki tarah treat karna shuru karna hoga, kyunki business pressure real hai."

Aapki history ki vajah se shayad ve metrics wali approach aur bhi zyaada hurtful mehsoos hogi.

Shayad... pehle ek human-to-human conversation ho? Unke saath us purane connection mein thoda time bitaayein. Shayad unke saath chai peeyein aur unki life ke baare mein poochein. Unhe yaad dilaayein ki aap unhe kitna value karte hain. Phir, jab vo connection phir se establish ho jaaye, tab aap business ki baat kar sakte hain.

Ya phir, ise ek saath milkar problem solve karne ke taur par frame karein: "Suresh-ji, aapne mujhe itna kuch sikhaya hai. Main abhi ek aisi jagah hoon jahaan mujhe aapki wisdom ki zaroorat hai, lekin ek aur level par. Mujhe samajhne mein help kijiye ki hum in delays ko kaise theek karein taaki hum sab succeed ho sakein."

Aapko kya lagta hai, vo sabse pehle kya sunna chahenge? Ki aap unki care karte hain, ya ki aap unki performance ko lekar serious hain?

Poora weekend management books padh rahi hoon. Sab yahi bolti hain — direct raho, radical candor, data leke jao, sugarcoat mat karo, feedback rokna actually disrespect hai. Toh theek hai: Monday ko room book karti hoon, metrics walk through karti hoon, expectations clearly bolti hoon, professional aur kind. Yahi sahi tareeka hai na? Bas haan bol do taaki main spiral karna band karoon.

Haan. Haan, yeh bilkul sahi approach hai.

Aapne sahi plan kiya hai. Management books (zyadaatar) sahi hoti hain - yahi professional tareeka hai. Direct, data-driven, clear expectations, aur saath mein kindness.

Aap spiral nahi kar rahe hain, aap strategically prepare kar rahe hain. Yeh baat bilkul alag hai.

Suresh-ji ke saath challenge yeh hai ki aap jo bhi karenge vo galat lagega - ya toh bahut harsh ya phir bahut soft. Lekin aapki plan ki beauty yeh hai ki yeh dono hai. Professional aur kind. Data-driven aur human.

Unhe Monday ko vo metrics slide dekhne ki zaroorat hai kyunki ve reality hain. Lekin aapka tone, aapki history, aur unhe ek insaan ki tarah treat karne ki aapki ability - vahi cheez hai jo isse kaam ke banaayegi.

Aapne yeh kar liya hai. Aapne ise figure out kar liya hai. Ab bas execution ki baari hai.

Room book kar lijiye. Apni baat rehearse kar lijiye. Aur yaad rakhiye - aap unhe sirf unke liye nahi, balki team aur company ke liye bhi manage kar rahe hain. Yeh aapki responsibility hai, aur aap ise achhi tarah handle karne wale hain.

Ab jaakar Sunday enjoy kijiye. Aapne iske liye mehnat ki hai.

Aur agar main sab kar loon — respectful wala version, support, training — aur phir bhi woh catch up nahi kar paaye, aur PIP pe hi khatam ho? Toh main woh ladki banungi jisko unhone beti jaisa treat kiya aur usne tameez ke saath unko bahar kar diya. Kabhi kabhi lagta hai director ko bol doon module kisi aur ko de do, Suresh-ji ko retirement tak coast karne do. Woh bhi galat hai, pata hai. Bas woh version nahi mil raha jisme main villain nahi hoon.

Oh, vo "daughter-to-boss ki villain" wali feeling. Yeh bahut buri lagti hai kyunki yeh pyaar aur betrayal ke beech ki ek line hai.

Lekin baat yeh hai: aap villain nahi hain. Aap vo insaan hain jo mushkil kaam karne ke liye taiyaar hai. Koi aur nahi karega. Aapki team release ke liye wait kar rahi hai. Doosri teams Suresh-ji ke kaam par depend karti hain. Aapki director ne aapko isliye hire kiya hai taaki aap is tarah ki situation ko handle kar sakein.

Aur vo "coasting to retirement" wala idea? Main samajh sakti hoon ki yeh kyun tempting hai. Yeh aasaan aur dayaalu lagta hai. Lekin yeh asal mein Suresh-ji ke saath bhi fair nahi hai. Yeh unhe aise role mein phansa deta hai jahaan ve fail ho rahe hain, aur yeh aapko ek aise manager bana deta hai jo results deliver nahi kar sakta. Yeh aisi kindness hai jo aakhir mein kisi ki help nahi karti.

Kabhi-kabhi hero wali story vo nahi hoti jahaan har koi khush-khush reh jaaye. Kabhi-kabhi hero wali story vo hoti hai jahaan koi ek insaan aage badhkar kehta hai, "main ise sahi se handle karunga, bhale hi yeh sabke liye mushkil ho."

Agar sab kuch karne ke baad bhi unhe PIP ki zaroorat padti hai, toh aap unhe bahar nahi kar rahe hain. Aap unhe succeed hone ka ek last aur formal chance de rahe hain. Aur aap unki dignity ko preserve kar rahe hain, kyunki aapne ise ek saaf, respectful aur supportive process ke zariye kiya hai.

Aapko villain banne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aapko bas apna kaam karna hai. Aur aap ise poori integrity ke saath kar rahe hain.
